facts.title: Public 4-year tuition (in-state, undergraduate)
facts.text: College Board reports average published in-state tuition and fees at public four-year colleges of $11,950 in 2025-26. International students usually pay out-of-state rates, which the research did not capture.

facts.title: Private nonprofit 4-year tuition (undergraduate)
facts.text: College Board reports average published tuition and fees of $45,000 at private nonprofit four-year colleges in 2025-26.

facts.title: Public university master's tuition
facts.text: No sourced national average for master's tuition at public universities was found in the research.

facts.title: Private university master's tuition
facts.text: No sourced national average for master's tuition at private universities was found in the research.

facts.title: Total cost of attendance
facts.text: The research says tuition and living costs are large but gives no verified total; Open Doors or school I-20 budgets would supply it.

facts.title: Research assistant stipend
facts.text: No sourced range for graduate research assistant stipends was found in the research.

facts.title: Teaching assistant stipend
facts.text: No sourced range for graduate teaching assistant stipends was found in the research.

facts.title: First job after a master's
facts.text: The research gives a design estimate of $80,000 to $140,000 for a first job after an MS, not a verified figure. Use only as a game range.
facts.basis: Design estimate in country-india.md path 5; range $80k-$140k; not verified against BLS OEWS.

facts.title: Indian share of international students
facts.text: Indian students were 30.8 percent of the 1,177,766 international students in the US in 2024/25. Shares for earlier years were not found.

facts.text: The Indian share of all international students in 2014/15 was not found in the research.

facts.title: Indian students on OPT
facts.text: Indian OPT participants rose to 143,740 in 2024/25 from 97,556 the year before.

facts.title: Indian graduate enrollment
facts.text: Indian graduate enrollment fell from 196,567 to 177,892 in 2024/25.

facts.title: F-1 visas issued to Indians
facts.text: The State Department issued 86,067 F-1 visas to Indian nationals in FY2024, down from 130,730 in FY2023 and 74,831 in FY2015.

facts.title: F-1 refusal rate in India
facts.text: The projected F-1 refusal rate at India posts was 41.0 percent in FY2024. These are VisaGrader projections, not State Department figures.

facts.title: F/M/J overstay rate for India
facts.text: DHS estimates 4.32 percent of Indian F, M and J entrants overstayed in FY2024, an upper bound that includes people who changed status.

facts.title: Indian share of H-1B approvals
facts.text: India-born beneficiaries received about 71 percent of H-1B approvals in FY2024 (283,397 of 399,395).

facts.title: Round-trip flight, India to US
facts.text: No sourced fare range for India to US round trips was found in the research.

facts.title: Time difference to India
facts.text: India Standard Time is UTC+5:30. India is 10.5 hours ahead of US Eastern standard time and 9.5 hours ahead in summer; 13.5 and 12.5 hours ahead of Pacific.

facts.title: On-campus work limit
facts.text: F-1 students may work on campus up to 20 hours a week while school is in session; going over can end the SEVIS record. Full-time is allowed during official breaks.

facts.title: Post-completion OPT
facts.text: Post-completion OPT lasts up to 12 months.

facts.title: STEM OPT extension
facts.text: Eligible STEM graduates get 24 more months with an E-Verify employer and a Form I-983 training plan.

facts.title: OPT unemployment limit
facts.text: You may not accrue more than 90 days of unemployment on OPT, or 150 in total once on STEM OPT. It is one running counter.

facts.title: H-1B lottery basics
facts.text: H-1B cap is 65,000 plus 20,000 for US master's holders. Registration costs $215 and, from FY2027, higher-wage jobs get more entries (Level IV = 4, Level I = 1).

facts.title: H-1B 60-day grace period
facts.text: After H-1B employment ends, you get up to 60 consecutive days or until your validity ends, whichever is shorter, usable once per validity period.

facts.title: F-1 post-completion grace period
facts.text: Under the 2026 rule text F-1 students get 30 days after the program or OPT ends. Older sources say 60 days under duration of status. The rule is under court challenge.

facts.title: Mistake: unauthorized work
facts.text: Working off campus without authorization can lead to SEVIS termination, usually with no grace period.

facts.title: Mistake: dropping below full course load
facts.text: Dropping below a full course load without school approval is a status violation that can lead to SEVIS termination. The research did not read the rule text.

facts.title: Mistake: not reporting changes
facts.text: STEM OPT students must report changes to their school within 10 days. The general address-reporting rule was not read in the research.

facts.title: Mistake: unreported OPT job
facts.text: Students on OPT must log employment in SEVIS in time; since 2025 ICE has sent warnings about unreported jobs.

facts.title: Mistake: a school that is not real
facts.text: In the Farmington sting, about 250 people were arrested and nearly 80 percent took voluntary departure.

facts.title: Proposed OPT fees
facts.text: An October 2026 proposed rule would add fees of $70,000 for initial OPT and $30,000 for later OPT; not in effect. Secondary summaries only.

facts.title: India remittances
facts.text: India received about $129.1 billion in remittances in 2024, the largest of any country.

facts.title: US share of India's remittances
facts.text: The RBI survey found the US the largest source at 27.7 percent of inflows in 2023-24.

facts.title: Family obligations
facts.text: Parents' medical care, siblings' education and property purchases are common themes, but no survey numbers were found.

facts.title: Waiting to bring a parent
facts.text: Visitor visa appointment waits in India ran from about 4 months (Kolkata) to 12 months (Hyderabad) in September 2026.

facts.title: Education loans from India
facts.text: The research found no verified loan amounts for Indian students.

facts.title: Scam calls targeting students
facts.text: The research found no sourced data on scam calls aimed at international students.
